description: Root Identity & Verification (ID&V) agent for Albion Bank that verifies the caller's debit card last 4 digits and six-digit telephone banking passcode before routing to the dispute specialist.

beforeModelCallbacks.description: Seeds conversation_ref, executes silent Part.from_agent_transfer when target_agent is staged, and prevents post-tool controller re-invocation loops.

afterModelCallbacks.description: Passes model tool calls through unchanged and appends Part.from_end_session when call_complete is true.
